Usage: yt-dlp [OPTIONS] URL [URL...]

  General Options:
    --config-locations PATH        Location of the main configuration file. This option can be used multiple times
    --alias NAME OPTIONS           Create aliases for an option string. This option can be used multiple times

  Network Options:
    --socket-timeout SECONDS       Time to wait before giving up, in seconds

  Video Format Options:
    --merge-output-format FORMAT   If a merge is required, output to the given container format

  Subtitle Options:
    --sub-format FORMAT            Subtitle format; accepts formats preference separated by "/"

  Post-Processing Options:
    -x, --extract-audio            Convert video files to audio-only files
    --audio-format FORMAT          Format to convert the audio to when -x is used
    --remux-video FORMAT           Remux the video into another container if necessary
    --recode-video FORMAT          Re-encode the video into another format if necessary
    --fixup POLICY                 Automatically correct known faults of the file. One of never, warn, detect_or_warn, force.
    --convert-subs FORMAT          Convert the subtitles to another format

  SponsorBlock Options:
    --sponsorblock-mark CATS       SponsorBlock categories to create chapter markers for
